# Bulk URL Opener

Bulk URL Opener is a free online tool that helps users open multiple URLs instantly.

Website:
https://urlopener.site/

About:
Bulk URL Opener allows users to paste multiple website links and open them together in separate browser tabs.

Features:

- Open multiple URLs with one click
- Free browser-based URL opener
- No software installation required
- No signup required
- Useful for SEO professionals, developers, marketers and researchers
